inspectionReport.en: Light wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Weapon systems operating normally. Energy storage fully charged and operating normally. Service normal. ECU in good condition.

text.en: R&V Model witchcraft operation platform PhonoR-0, Rhodes Island's first and only intelligent operation platform equipped with a Banshee incantation Arts device. Unlike the customized Raythean Industries models, she was born from the unbreakable rapport between our most skilled operators and the Banshees. Compared to other wheeled operation platforms, the witchcraft-based components in her operating mechanisms, drive system, and core more closely resemble a mobile altar. Despite being the product of both cutting-edge technology and Sarkaz witchcraft, her basic specs are unimpressive, but she is easy to deploy and able to provide mid-mission assistance to operators. She currently participates in combat missions as a Supporter Operator.
text.zh: R&V型巫术作业平台PhonoR-0，罗德岛首款且唯一一款搭载女妖咒言法器的智能作业平台。与其他客制化的雷神工业作业平台不同，她的诞生离不开罗德岛干员的顶尖技术与女妖们之间的默契。从其运行机构、传动系统及核心的巫术元件的设计来看，比起轮式作业平台，PhonoR-0更像一座移动的巫术祭坛。作为尖端工业技术与萨卡兹巫术结合的产物，PhonoR-0的基本性能并不出众，但她易于部署，能随时对行动干员进行支援，现作为辅助干员参与相关作战任务。

text.en: After PhonoR-0 was formally inducted as a member of Rhodes Island, some elite operators aware of the situation made bets in private. They were curious as to how much this emissary of the Banshees would affect Logos's personal life. There were also busybodies like Closure who took an interest in the former Great Banshee. After all, 'sending one's voice over' was seen as an incredibly strange act to other Sarkaz. In the end, though, nothing really changed. Logos paid no heed to the unusual 'elder' often by his side. At times, they would go on walks on the deck together. While Rhodes Island was preparing to leave Londinium, PhonoR-0 proved to be a big help in our final few operations. She even accepted being the subject of Closure's research without hesitation. Whenever she heard amusing anecdotes about Logos from other operators, she would politely ask them to repeat themselves slowly so she could record their stories and send them back to the Convallis of the Banshees. On occasion, and only on occasion, operators having a few drinks at Just One More Pint would notice that PhonoR-0 had replaced the usual jukebox. Most times, she would simply quietly emit a red light while playing gentle melodies the operators at the bar had never heard. But whenever Logos came by, a melodious Banshee chant would find itself on the playlist. Her voice sounds as though it comes from the other side of this great land, passing through the Convallis and the crystal arches studded across the earth. It was not long before she received an invitation to join Rhodes Island's choir.
text.zh:
PhonoR-0正式成为罗德岛的一员之后，精英干员中的几位知情者私下打起了赌。他们十分好奇这位女妖们的使者，会在多大程度上影响Logos的生活。另有一些像可露希尔这样的“好事者”，则对那一位前任大女妖产生了兴趣，毕竟，“将自己的声音送来”在其他萨卡兹看来也是件不可思议的事。
结果一切如常，Logos并不介意身边多出这样一位特殊的“长辈”，他们有时还会一同在甲板上散步。在本舰准备离开伦蒂尼姆的那段日子里，PhonoR-0为我们的收尾行动提供了大量帮助，她甚至毫无防备地接受了可露希尔的“研究”。只有从其他干员那里听说了Logos的趣事的时候，PhonoR-0才会礼貌地请对方讲慢一些，方便自己留下记录将来送回河谷。
偶尔，只是偶尔——去“再来一杯”小酌的干员会发现，本该摆着点唱机的地方，赫然是PhonoR-0的身影。大多数情况下，她只是平静地散发着红光，在吧台一旁为干员们播放他们从未听过的柔和旋律。但当Logos也来到吧台前方时，悠扬的女声吟唱便会加入旋律之中。她的声音仿佛来自大地的彼端，穿过河谷，穿过被晶簇拱起的土地。
很快，PhonoR-0就收到了来自罗德岛合唱团的盛情邀请。
